description: Position Overview The Digital Tracking Specialist is a skilled, detail-oriented professional with 2+ years of  experience in conversion tracking and tag management. This role is critical for ensuring precise data capture and attribution across digital channels, supporting accurate campaign performance measurement. You’ll act as the technical backbone for tracking setups, guiding clients and internal teams on best practices for capturing meaningful insights and maximizing marketing Why Join Us? Work in a dynamic, growth-focused digital marketing environment. Collaborate with a global team of experts in paid media and analytics. Competitive compensation and continuous learning opportunities. Opportunities for career progression within the Paid Media team, including senior roles and leadership tracks. Job Descriptions Tag Management and Conversion Tracking - Implement and manage conversion tracking setups for major advertising platforms, including Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, Microsoft Ads, and others. - Build and maintain tracking solutions using Google Tag Manager (GTM), including event tracking, custom triggers, and data layer integration. - Ensure accurate data collection for offline conversions, first-party data, and advanced event tracking. - Set up consent management tools to ensure tracking compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA). - Implement data layer and cookie storage solutions to capture UTM parameters, session data, and lead attribution information, ensuring accurate tracking across multiple visits. - Ensure form tracking setups can pass stored data to CRMs or analytics platforms for complete funnel visibility. - Collaborate with developers to integrate tracking scripts and maintain data integrity across touchpoints. Call Tracking and Data Integration - Set up and manage call tracking systems (e.g., Call Tracking Metrics, CallRail) to capture and attribute offline conversions effectively. - Work with popular CMS platforms (e.g., Shopify, WordPress) to integrate and maintain tracking plugins for seamless data transfer. -Integrate CRM platforms like HubSpot or Salesforce for data synchronization and lead tracking. Troubleshooting and Optimization - Validate tracking setups to confirm accurate data flow from site to analytics platforms, reducing discrepancies. - Perform regular audits and quality assurance checks to ensure accurate data capture and conversion tracking across platforms. - Troubleshoot tracking issues, including tag misfires, data discrepancies, and pixel errors, ensuring accurate conversion reporting. Team Communication & Project Management - Collaborate with Account Managers and Analysts to scope and execute tracking projects within defined budgets and timelines. - Maintain clear and concise documentation for tracking setups, ensuring a smooth handoff to internal teams. Continuous Learning and Industry Awareness - Stay up-to-date with the latest platform updates, tracking technologies, and best practices for digital marketing measurement. - Monitor changes in data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and ensure ongoing compliance for all tracking setups. - Research and evaluate emerging tracking tools and server-side technologies, identifying opportunities for future service offerings. - Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, providing training and support to tea ---------- mbers on tracking best practices and tools. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS - 2+ years of hands-on experience in conversion tracking and tag management, including GTM. - Strong understanding of first-party and offline conversion tracking strategies. - Comfort with call tracking tools like Call Tracking Metrics or CallRail, including setup and integration. - Familiarity with major CMS platforms like Shopify and WordPress, particularly for tracking plugin configurations. - Strong analytical mindset and troubleshooting skills for resolving tracking discrepancies. - Understanding of data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) as they relate to tracking and data management. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. - Proficiency with communication and project management tools (Asana and Slack) PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - 4+ years of hands-on experience in conversion tracking and tag management. - Experience with other tag managers like Tealium, Adobe Launch, or Segment. - Experience with server-side tracking and solutions like BigQuery or Snowplow (future service offering potential).

Are you a detail-driven marketing operator who thrives on structure, systems, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks? Token of Trust is looking for a Marketing Coordinator to help power the day-to-day execution of our Growth team and keep our marketing engine running smoothly.

HELLO!

Hey, I’m Austin, and I lead Growth at Token of Trust. We’re not a startup — we’ve been around for over a decade, building trust and identity solutions for ecommerce businesses, and many of our remote team members have grown with us over the years. We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of our Growth team. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on structure, organization, and execution. You’ll keep content calendars full, tasks tracked, and cross-functional projects moving — strategy is set, your job is to make it deliverable.

Our team operates on a hybrid Customer-Led Growth (CLG) and Product-Led Growth (PLG) model, which demands tight coordination, clean systems, and disciplined execution. If you love organized boards, smooth workflows, and seeing projects go from “idea” to “published” without chaos — you’ll fit right in.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

CONTENT CALENDAR MANAGEMENT
- Own and maintain our marketing content calendar across blog and social (LinkedIn, Facebook)
- Ensure content is always scheduled at least 1–2 weeks in advance to avoid gaps
- Coordinate timelines with writers, designers, and the Head of Marketing to keep deliverables on track
- QA and upload blog content into CMS (WordPress), format for readability, and ensure all links/UTMs/CTAs are correct
- Schedule and publish social posts via Meta Business Suite or similar tools
- Design blog graphics, social media visuals, and lightweight reels or video snippets for posts

Task & Project Coordination
- Create and manage Trello cards for all marketing tasks — no important item should go undocumented
- Ensure every task card includes: Acceptance Criteria, Release Notes, and Risk Checklist (if applicable) before it moves to “In Progress”
- Track weekly priorities, manage the sprint board, and surface blockers when needed
- Maintain visibility into both committed work and in-progress items to help the team meet deadlines

Cross-Functional Support
- Intake requests from other departments via the Growth team’s Trello inbox and ensure timely follow-up
- Support cross-functional execution — email sends, campaign QA, partner collateral updates, etc.
- Assist with formatting and publishing marketing materials, blog posts, and newsletters

Ops & Reporting
- Support weekly reporting on marketing metrics, completed activities, and process improvements
- Help enforce consistency around folder organization, UTMs, naming conventions, and metadata tracking

What You Bring:
- 1–3 years of experience in marketing coordination, project management, editorial operations, or content marketing
- Highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented — you love clarity, checklists, and closing the loop
- Comfortable managing and enforcing process in Trello (or similar task management tools)
- Confident using WordPress, social schedulers (e.g., Buffer, Later, Meta Suite), and Google Workspace
- Intermediate SEO knowledge — including keyword research, on-page optimization, internal linking, metadata, and basic content performance analysis
- Clear written communication and professional follow-through
- Design experience using Canva, Figma, or similar tools to create marketing visuals and short-form content
- Familiarity with B2B SaaS marketing and content performance reporting is a plus

WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY
- Flexible schedule with required attendance at key meetings in Central Time and at least 2 hours of CST overlap daily
- Opportunity to grow into full-time with incentives and bonuses
- Access to professional marketing tools
- Long-term stability
- Real ownership of operational marketing execution

HOW TO APPLY
We’re looking for more than just a resume show us your skills! Drop us a message or send your resume highlighting your relevant background.

To apply:
1) Put the word “trust” in your subject line.
Applications without this word in the subject line will not be reviewed.

2) In the first line of your message, list the 3 most important requirements you noticed in this job post.

3) Then answer the questions below in your application message:
Why are you a strong fit for this role?
In 150–200 words, explain why you are a good fit for this position. Reference 2 specific responsibilities from this job post and tell us which tools or workflows you’ve used that are most similar.

Content Project Example
Describe one specific blog post or content project you personally coordinated from start to publish. Please include:
- Company or brand name
- CMS used
- Who else was involved
- 3 specific steps you handled yourself
- Any SEO steps you implemented
- 1 issue, delay, or problem you had to solve
- Measurable outcomes
- A live link to the published piece

Social Post Example
Provide one real example of a social post you personally scheduled. Please include:
- Platform
- Exact caption
- Goal of the post
- Why you chose that timing
- Results achieved
- A live link or screenshot of the post

If your experience seems like a strong match, we’ll be in touch to discuss next steps.

If you’re passionate about technology, enjoy tackling new challenges, and want to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you. Let’s build something incredible together!

title: Elementor Website Builder (Full-Time)
description: We run a web design agency in the US that builds websites for home service contractors. Since 2014, we have worked with a team in the Philippines, and value the culture very much. We currently need a full-time Elementor builder to produce client websites from designs that are already approved. You will receive a fully approved website design as a live HTML preview you can view in your browser, along with all the written content, images, brand colors, and fonts. Your job is to take that approved design and rebuild it in WordPress using Elementor Pro. Accurately, efficiently, and with clean structure. But the job does not stop at building. We also need you to push sites live on client domains, manage DNS, optimize page speed, and handle basic WordPress security. If your experience is limited to building inside Elementor and handing it off to someone else for deployment, this is probably not the right fit. What you will do every day: - Open an approved website preview side by side with Elementor and build the homepage to match it as closely as possible - Copy and paste pre-written content into each section (all copy is provided to you) - Upload and place images into the correct sections (all images are provided and sized) - Set up the color palette, fonts, and spacing to match the approved design - Build inner pages (About, Services, Contact, Service Area) following the same design style - Make sure every page is fully mobile responsive - Use proper heading structure: one H1 per page, H2s for sections, H3s for subsections - Test the site on desktop, tablet, and mobile before marking it complete - Make revisions when our team or the client requests changes Technical responsibilities beyond building: - Point client domains to our hosting by updating A records, CNAME records, or nameservers. You should know the difference between updating nameservers vs updating individual DNS records and when to use which approach. - Verify that DNS changes have propagated using tools like ---------- or similar DNS checkers - Set up or verify SSL certificates on new sites. Most of our hosting handles this automatically, but you need to troubleshoot when it does not. - Migrate completed sites from staging to a live domain using tools like Duplicator, All-in-One WP Migration, or similar. You should be comfortable with this process and have done it multiple times. - Optimize page speed after every build. This includes compressing and converting images to WebP, installing and configuring a caching plugin (WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, or similar), deferring or delaying non-critical JavaScript, reducing render-blocking CSS, and minimizing plugin count. Our target is 80+ on Google PageSpeed Insights for mobile. 90+ is what we aim for. - Handle basic WordPress security on every new site: change the default login URL, install a security plugin (Wordfence or similar), limit login attempts, disable comments and user registration if not needed, set up reCAPTCHA or WP Armor on forms, and remove unused plugins and themes. What we provide to you for every project: - A live preview URL showing the exact approved design - All page content (headlines, body text, CTAs) written and ready to paste in - All images sized and ready to upload - Brand colors as hex codes and font names - A structured handoff document listing everything you need - Pre-built Elementor template sections you can import and customize - Access to our hosting and staging environments You must have: - At least 2 years of hands-on experience building websites in WordPress with Elementor Pro - Direct experience managing DNS records (A records, CNAME records, nameservers, MX records). Not just knowing the terms, but having done it yourself across different registrars like GoDaddy, Namecheap, or Cloudflare. - Experience migrating WordPress sites from staging to production using Duplicator, All-in-One WP Migration, or manual migration via database export and file transfer - Proven ability to optimize page speed. You should consistently hit 80+ on Google PageSpeed Insights mobile and know how to get there. - Strong attention to detail. You can look at a design and match it closely in Elementor without needing someone to hold your hand through it. - Solid understanding of responsive design. Sites need to look great on all screen sizes. - Understanding of SEO structure. Proper heading hierarchy (H1, H2, H3), alt text on images, clean semantic page structure. - Basic WordPress security knowledge. You should know how to lock down a fresh install without being told what to do. - Reliable internet and a computer that can run WordPress smoothly - Ability to work during or overlap with US Central Time hours - Good English communication. You will get instructions and give updates through chat. Bonus (not required but will put you ahead): - Experience with Elementor template kits or reusable section templates - Experience building sites for home service companies like contractors, plumbers, or roofers - Comfort writing custom CSS to handle small design tweaks instead of installing a plugin - Experience with cPanel, Cloudways, RunCloud, GridPane, or managed WordPress hosting platforms - Familiarity with WordPress plugins like Yoast SEO, Rank Math, WPForms, WP Rocket, Smush, or ShortPixel - Experience setting up Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or Google Search Console on client sites - Basic knowledge of schema markup or structured data What this role is not: - Not a graphic design job. You will not be designing layouts from scratch. - Not a content writing job. All copy is written before it reaches you. - Not a full stack development job. But we do need someone comfortable with basic CSS, DNS, and WordPress administration beyond just the Elementor editor. - Not a one-time project. This is ongoing full-time work with a steady flow of sites to build. How our process works: 1. Our design tool generates a website preview and the client approves it 2. Our content team writes all the page copy 3. We put together a handoff package with the preview, content, images, and brand details 4. You build it in Elementor (target is 2 to 4 hours per homepage, 1 to 2 hours per inner page) 5. You optimize page speed and run through our pre-launch checklist 6. You point the client domain to our hosting and push the site live 7. Our team reviews the live site 8. You make any adjustments needed We expect to start with 2 to 3 websites per week and grow from there. This is a long-term position for someone who wants stable, consistent work with a growing agency. Pay: $900 to $1,400 USD per month depending on experience, speed, and technical ability. Paid weekly through Wise or PayPal. Candidates who can demonstrate strong page speed optimization and DNS management skills will start at the higher end. Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week. Hours are flexible but you need overlap with US Central Time for communication. How to apply: Do not send a generic application. Include the following: 1. A link to 2 or 3 websites you built in Elementor (not designed, built). Tell me which ones you personally built. 2. How many years you have been using Elementor specifically. 3. On average, how long does it take you to build a homepage in Elementor when you already have the design and content provided? 4. Have you personally managed DNS records to point a domain to hosting? If yes, briefly describe a time you did this. If no, just say no. 5. What is your typical Google PageSpeed Insights score on mobile for sites you have built? What steps do you take to get there? 6. Have you migrated a WordPress site from staging to a live domain? What tool did you use? 7. Write the word "developer" at the top of your application so I know you read this entire post. We read every application that follows these instructions. Looking forward to hearing from you.

This is an entry-level marketing role built for someone who wants to learn digital marketing by actually doing it — inside a real agency, on real client accounts, with a team that will train you properly and invest in your growth.

We're not looking for someone who already knows everything. We're looking for someone who follows instructions precisely, executes with care, and takes pride in getting the details right every single time.

If you're a recent graduate or early-career professional who is coachable, highly organized, and ready to commit fully to a long-term role — read on.

What This Role Is:

You'll work inside a structured marketing system, executing weekly deliverables across website management, local SEO, email/SMS marketing, and client reporting. Much of your work involves recurring tasks with documented processes — and following those processes precisely is a real skill we take seriously.

But we're not looking for someone who needs to be told what to do next. The best people on our team see what needs to be done, do it, and flag anything that doesn't look right. They take ownership of their work, not just their task list.

Success in this role looks like: consistent execution, zero dropped balls, and a quiet confidence that if something falls under your responsibility — it's handled.

What You'll Do:

In the first month, you'll shadow our Marketing Manager and learn our systems hands-on. By month two, you'll be executing independently. By month three, you'll own a full client workload.

Day-to-day responsibilities include:

- Update client websites in WordPress (specials, events, gallery, blog posts, landing pages)
- Manage Google Business Profiles (photo uploads, review replies)
- Collect and organize weekly reporting data (metric screenshots, tracking sheet updates)
- Support email and SMS campaign execution in our retention platform (full training provided)
- Maintain content calendars and ensure deliverables stay on schedule
- Log tasks and progress in ClickUp daily

What We're Looking For:

Non-negotiable:

- Conscientious and detail-oriented — you catch your own errors, you don't cut corners, and you care about quality in routine work
- Ability to follow SOPs — you can read a documented process and execute it the same way every time
- Strong written English — clear, professional communication; able to produce client-facing content without heavy editing
- AI proficiency — comfortable using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools as part of your daily workflow
- Reliable internet and computer
- Fully available — this role requires your complete professional focus from month two onward (40 hours/week, Monday–Friday)

Helpful but trainable:

- Experience with WordPress, Google Sheets, or email marketing platforms
- Canva or basic design skills
- Familiarity with local SEO concepts
- Google Business Profile management experience
- A college degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field is preferred — not because credentials matter more than character, but because this role attracts people who want to build a real career in marketing, and we want someone who sees this as a starting point, not a stopgap.

A Note on Commitment:

We'll be direct: this is a full-time position that requires your complete, undivided professional focus — especially from month two onward at 40 hours per week. We're a small, high-output team and we need someone who is fully in.

We've hired people in the past who treated this like a side job. That doesn't work here. If you have existing obligations that would prevent you from committing fully, please be upfront about that before we begin the process.

For the right person — someone who takes ownership, communicates proactively, and shows up fully — this is a long-term role with real room to grow in both responsibilities and compensation. We promote from within. The last person hired into this role was promoted to Marketing Manager within one year.

If you're an A-player ready to commit, this is a place where your work will actually matter.

Compensation & Hours:

Month 1 (Training Period):
- 30 hours/week
- $600/month
- Shadow our Marketing Manager, learn all systems, begin supervised execution

Month 2 onward:
- 40 hours/week
- $800/month

Month 6:
- Performance review with opportunity for a raise

Hours are flexible within the Monday–Friday window. We care about output and on-time delivery, not when you're online. Time and PTO are tracked via a time-tracking app.

Benefits:
- 13th month pay
- 10 paid holidays per year
- Paid Time Off (begins accruing after probation period)
- Fully remote
- Flexible schedule
- Growth path — we promote from within and reward people who invest in the role

About LeafSuite:

LeafSuite (leafsuite.io) is a US-based digital marketing agency that serves independent cannabis dispensaries. We help dispensary owners grow their customer base and revenue through retention marketing, local SEO, and website operations.
Cannabis is a legal, regulated industry in the United States, and all of our clients are licensed businesses. This role requires genuine openness to learning about cannabis culture, products, and the dispensary industry — not just tolerating it, but engaging with it well enough to do good work for our clients. If that's not something you're comfortable with, this role isn't the right fit.

How to Apply:

Apply with the subject line: Focused on Marketing – [Your Name]

Include:
- A brief overview of your marketing background or education
- An example of a recurring task you've owned and how you made sure it got done consistently
- Confirmation that this would be your sole professional commitment
- Your ideal working hours (when you get your best work done).

Please write your application in your own words. We're not looking for a polished, perfect response — we're looking for yours. An application that sounds like it was written by an AI tells us nothing about you. Imperfect sentences that are genuinely yours tell us a lot. If we can't hear your voice in your application, we'll move on.

Bonus points if you include your DISC assessment results — either displayed on your profile or attached to your application. Not required, but it helps us get to know you faster.

We review every application. We respond to candidates who follow the instructions.

Thank you — and have a great day!

title: Content Operations Manager
description: Happy Thursday! Thank you so much for taking the time to review our job posting. ???? Priority will be given to applicants who: - Write an ORIGINAL cover letter/response that directly addresses our requirements (i.e. not copied/pasted to high-volume applications). - Do NOT use ChatGPT / AI tools to write your cover letter. We want to meet YOU first — your voice, your thinking, your honesty. (We’re not anti-AI; we just want your application to reflect you.) ===== ABOUT US ===== We’re Agency — a small (intentionally small), values-centric fractional marketing team serving ambitious, ROI-driven clients. We take our work seriously, but we also take care of each other. We’re big believers in: - Clear communication - Kindness + professionalism - Doing excellent work without burning people out - Building long-term working relationships (not revolving-door hiring) If you’re the kind of person who takes pride in quality, communicates honestly, and likes being part of a team that truly supports one another — we’d love to hear from you. ===== OUR MISSION ===== Our fiduciary duty is to provide our clients with integrity-led marketing centered on measurable ROI and delivering value long after our work is done. ===== OUR VALUES ===== We hire for alignment with our values and candidate transparency/honesty above all else. We’re proud of how much our team cares — about our clients, about the work, and about doing right by each other. Candor as a Compass ---------- Our word is our bond. We communicate honestly, clearly, and directly — even when it’s hard — because trust is everything. Purpose Over Profit ---------- We only take partnerships we truly believe in, where we can deliver meaningful, lasting impact. Double or Nothing Approach ---------- We aim for total conviction that every dollar billed is likely to return multiples in long-term value. Data Tell the Story ---------- We prioritize based on evidence. If it doesn’t show up in the data, it doesn’t count. Fail Forward Philosophy ---------- We take smart swings, learn fast, and improve relentlessly — without blame, ego, or drama. ===== ROLE OVERVIEW ===== We’re hiring a full-time Content Operations Manager to own editorial quality, content planning, SEO viability, and process improvement across our content team. This is NOT a “calendar-only” role and it’s NOT “just editing.” This is a leadership + systems role for someone who can: - Ensure every deliverable is on track and meets our standards - Final-approve ALL content going out the door - Build and improve the systems that make the team faster without sacrificing quality - Use AI for speed, while applying strong human editorial judgment to produce content that ranks and converts If you thrive when you’re accountable for outcomes, love clean processes, and have a sharp editorial eye — you’ll fit in well here. ===== WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE ===== - Client content deliverables ship on time, consistently - Editorial quality is noticeably higher (clarity, structure, voice, logic, evidence) - SEO content is built to rank (not just “written about a keyword”) - Conversion/influence content is persuasive and brand-aligned (not generic) - The team moves faster over time because your systems, templates, QA steps, and AI prompts are improving continuously ===== KEY RESPONSIBILITIES ===== Content Leadership + Final Approval (Quality Gate) - Final approval of ALL content team deliverables before anything is sent to clients or published - Enforce editorial standards: clarity, logic, structure, tone/voice, credibility, and usefulness - Ensure content aligns to the content brief, client goals, and intended audience - Reject content that doesn’t meet standards (kindly but clearly) and provide actionable revision steps Content Planning + Delivery Management - Own the content calendar and ensure deliverables stay on track - Proactively surface risks: blockers, missing inputs, bandwidth constraints, deadline slips - Coordinate with internal stakeholders (PM, SEO lead, account manager, etc.) to keep everything moving - Ensure briefs are strong enough that writers/designers can execute without chaos or guesswork SEO Strategy + Execution Oversight - Ensure SEO deliverables are viable: search intent match, topical completeness, internal linking opportunities, SERP alignment - Review outlines for depth, structure, and competitive coverage - Ensure on-page fundamentals are correct: titles, headers, meta, keyword usage (without robotic stuffing), and formatting - Coach and improve the team’s SEO execution over time AI + Process Design (Efficiency Without Compromise) - Maintain and improve prompts, templates, and workflows used for AI-assisted drafting - Ensure AI-generated drafts are editorialized into high-quality, human-sounding final work - Improve team SOPs, QA checklists, and handoff conventions - Reduce revision loops and prevent recurring mistakes through better systems (not more nagging) Client-Ready Standards - Ensure deliverables are “client-ready”: polished, aligned, and defensible - Maintain high trust through accuracy, consistency, and clear reasoning - Identify patterns in client feedback and solve upstream (process/briefing/prompting/training) ===== JOB REQUIREMENTS ===== - 35–40 hours per week (full-time); flexible working hours - Prompt communication and reliable follow-through - A dependable computer, stable power, high-speed internet + backup hotspot - Comfort using GSuite (Google Drive, Docs, Sheets) and basic Microsoft Office - Ability to accept payroll via Wise (formerly TransferWise) - Willingness to log hours using a time tracker (e.g. Hubstaff) ===== REQUIRED SKILLS / TRAITS (NON-NEGOTIABLE) ===== - Honesty and candid communication — even when it’s uncomfortable (We can work through almost anything with transparency. Trust is the only thing we can’t rebuild once broken.) - Native-level English fluency with deep editing experience (line editing + copy editing) - Strong editorial judgment: you can quickly identify what’s weak and explain how to fix it - Strong SEO understanding (search intent, SERP analysis, topical depth, on-page fundamentals) - Strong content planning/project management instincts (deadlines, capacity, dependencies) - Process design ability: you can build systems that are simple, repeatable, and scalable - Comfort using AI tools for drafting and analysis, without sacrificing originality, credibility, or quality - High standards, delivered with kindness (clear feedback without being harsh or ego-driven) - Strong attention to detail and fact-checking discipline ===== DESIRED SKILLS (BIG PLUS) ===== - Experience managing a multi-writer editorial team - Experience building SEO content engines (brief > outline > draft > edit > publish > optimize) - Familiarity with Surfer/Frase/Clearscope, Ahrefs/SEMrush, GA4, GSC, Looker Studio (any is fine) - Experience editing conversion-focused pages/emails (landing pages, homepages, nurture sequences) - Experience creating or improving AI prompts specifically for SEO outlines and drafts - Familiarity with WordPress and/or HubSpot CMS for basic formatting and publishing workflows ===== EXPECTATIONS ===== - Your manager will be there for you — and we will set you up for success — but… - After onboarding, you’ll be trusted with real autonomy and real accountability - You’ll be expected to think critically, prioritize intelligently, and keep the machine running - We have a strict policy against logging/billing hours when you aren’t actively working - If you can’t reach expected hours in a given week (sick, power outage, etc.), tell us as soon as possible - You will be the final quality gate — which means your judgment must be reliable and consistent ===== BENEFITS / HOW WE TAKE CARE OF OUR TEAM ===== We work hard to build a place people actually want to stay — and we back that up with action. - Paid Time Off (PTO) for full-time tea ---------- mbers (after probation) - Paid holidays, including a company-wide Christmas/New Year break (Dec 23 – Jan 1) - Regular raises and performance-based growth opportunities AND — one of our biggest commitments: - After 12 months of full-time employment, you become eligible for our 4-day workweek benefit: - 25% pay raise, and - 20% reduction in hours (Example: moving from ~40 hours/week to ~32 hours/week while keeping pay whole.) We don’t offer that to sound impressive. We offer it because we care about sustainability, family, health, and long-term performance. ===== HOW TO APPLY ===== Please include: 1) A short ORIGINAL cover letter answering: - Why this role is a fit for you (specifically) - Your editing + SEO strengths (what you’re best at) - An example of how you improved a content process (what changed and what improved) - Confirmation you’re comfortable with time tracking + full-time hours 2) 2–3 examples of work you’ve directly influenced (links are great), such as: - Content you edited that performed well (rankings, traffic, conversions, client results) - A content calendar or planning artifact you’ve managed (redact client names if needed) - A SOP, checklist, or process you built that improved quality and speed 3) A brief note on your experience using AI in content workflows: - What you use it for - What your quality-control approach is - How you prevent generic, low-quality output Optional (but helpful): include the phrase “Data Tell the Story” in your subject line so we know you read the full post. ===== CLOSING ===== Thank you again for your time and consideration. If you’re a high-integrity editor and systems thinker who loves building a content machine that produces work you’re proud of — and you want to do it inside a team that genuinely supports you — we’d love to hear from you. Have a wonderful rest of your week and weekend ahead. ????

description: POSITION: Conversion Web Operator (WordPress + Elementor) COMPANY: IT Tech Industry TYPE: Full-Time, Remote SALARY: $1,000-$1,200 / month --- You don't wait for a designer to hand you a mockup. Two or three live URLs of landing pages you personally built in Elementor. 2. For one of those pages — tell us in two sentences what you would change to improve its conversion rate today. 3. Your available start date.

description: WordPress Technical Specialist for Mission-Driven Pet Education Company Help Us Impact 1 Million Pet Parents by 2030 Pet Summits is on a mission to help pet parents around the world give their animals longer, healthier, and happier lives. We create online educational events that bring together leading veterinarians, pet health experts, trainers, and educators to help pet parents make better decisions for the animals they love. Our goal is to impact 1 million pet parents by the year 2030, and we are building the team, systems, and technology to make that possible. We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented WordPress Technical Specialist who can help us keep our event websites, funnels, automations, reports, and technical systems running smoothly as well as build automations to improve what we already have. This is not a basic VA role. It is also not a pure programming role. This is a hands-on technical role for someone who enjoys working inside WordPress, Thrive Themes, funnels, forms, plugins, reports, dashboards, and automations, while also helping improve the way our systems work over time. Why This Role Matters Every event we run helps thousands of pet parents learn how to better care for their pets. Your work will directly support that mission. When a registration page works properly, more pet parents can attend. When forms, tags, and automations are set up correctly, people receive the right email s at the right time. When dashboards and reports are accurate, our team can make better decisions. When systems are documented and improved, the whole company becomes stronger. This role is about more than updating pages. It is about helping build the technical foundation that allows Pet Summits to grow and create more impact. What You’ll Be Doing Your main focus will be supporting the technical setup and maintenance of our online events. This includes: - Setting up and updating WordPress pages using Thrive Themes / Thrive Architect. - Moving existing event pages into new event setups, including registration pages, speaker pages, thank-you pages, replay pages, and other funnel pages. - Making sure pages are formatted correctly, mobile responsive, and ready before launch. - Updating WordPress plugins and checking that updates do not break key pages or functionality. - Testing forms, buttons, links, redirects, thank-you pages, registration flows, and other important user journeys. - Making sure Kit / ConvertKit forms, tags, and integrations are connected properly. - Testing Zapier automations and making sure data is moving correctly between tools. - Helping create and maintain reports and dashboards for event performance. - Creating and improving technical checklists, SOPs, and QA processes. - Helping us improve existing systems so our event setup process becomes more reliable, scalable, and organized. - Troubleshooting basic WordPress, plugin, page builder, form, tracking, and integration issues. The Role Breakdown Approximately 70% of this role will be WordPress, Thrive Themes, event page setup, plugin updates, testing, QA, reporting, and creating automations with Thinkific, Samcart, etc. Approximately 30% of this role will be dashboards, automations, process improvement, systems optimization, and helping us scale our infrastructure. Tools & Skills We’re Looking For You should be comfortable with, or able to quickly learn: WordPress Thrive Themes / Thrive Architect Kit / ConvertKit Samcart Zapier Google Sheets Looker Studio or similar dashboard tools Google Analytics Google Tag Manager ClickUp or similar project management tools Basic HTML Basic CSS Basic understanding of PHP is a plus You do not need to be a senior developer, but you should be technically confident, detail-oriented, and comfortable troubleshooting when something does not work. You’ll Be a Great Fit If You Care about doing meaningful work. Enjoy working with WordPress, pages, plugins, forms, funnels, and technical systems. Are highly detail-oriented and like testing things properly before they go live. Understand that small technical mistakes can affect registrations, email s, sales, and customer experience. Can follow SOPs, but also suggest better ways to do things. Communicate clearly when something is unclear, broken, delayed, or needs support. Have a strong sense of ownership and responsibility. Are excited to be part of a mission-driven company helping pet parents around the world. Have a fast and stable internet connection. ## This Is Not the Right Fit If You Only want to do design work. Only want to do programming. Only know basic WordPress posting and formatting. Do not enjoy testing, checklists, details, or technical troubleshooting. Need constant supervision to complete tasks. Have unreliable internet. Avoid communicating when something is delayed or unclear. ## What’s In It For You - You’ll be part of a kind, mission-driven team doing work that genuinely helps pets and their families. - You’ll get to work on meaningful online events that reach thousands of pet parents. - You’ll have the opportunity to grow from technical execution into stronger systems, reporting, automation, and technical operations work. - You’ll be encouraged to improve processes, suggest better ways of doing things, and help build systems that scale. - You’ll be part of a company with a big vision: impacting 1 million pet parents by 2030. ## How to Apply Please include the following in your application: 1. Your experience with WordPress and Thrive Themes or similar page builders. 2. Your experience with Kit / ConvertKit, Zapier, dashboards, and reporting tools 3. Any experience with thinkific or samcart? . 4. Your salary expectations for this full-time roll 5. Examples of websites, funnels, dashboards, automations, or technical systems you have helped manage. 6. Your internet speed test screenshot. 7. A short explanation of how you would test a registration page before an event goes live. We are looking for someone reliable, thoughtful, technically capable, and excited to help us build the systems behind a mission that matters.

title: HubSpot Implementation Specialist
description: We need a senior, hands-on HubSpot Marketing Ops implementer to turn around our campaign operating model in 4 weeks. We’ve made some progress on lifecycle/MQL/scoring, but campaigns are not consistently set up, preventing reliable attribution and reporting. This is an implementation role (build/fix), not advisory. You must be able to execute independently, quickly, and accurately. What success looks like after 4 weeks - Campaign owners can launch campaigns using a repeatable checklist (naming, UTMs, asset association, QA) - HubSpot campaigns have consistent setup and correct asset association (email s, forms, landing pages, ads where applicable) - Campaign reporting shows contacts + conversions by campaign and can be validated against underlying records - MQL/lifecycle/scoring logic is aligned to a single source of truth (no conflicting “MQL” definitions) - Email health basics are in place (suppression, segmentation hygiene, unengaged approach) - Documentation + training are delivered so the team can maintain standards without constant support Scope & responsibilities 1) Campaign audit + Campaign checklist Audit the last 10–15 campaigns and identify where tracking breaks (UTMs, missing assets, dates, naming, conversion points) Create a Campaign “Definition of Done” checklist including: - naming convention - required campaign fields (owner, dates, goal, budget fields if used) - UTM standard + tracking URL process - asset association rules (email s/forms/pages/ads) - QA steps before launch 2) Campaign templates + operating model - Build reusable templates for key campaign types: - Webinar/Event - Content/Download - Paid/Partner - Standardise setup so attribution is consistent across campaign types - Implement lightweight governance to prevent regression (permissions/QA gate/approval step) 3) Attribution + reporting baseline for campaigns - Ensure conversion points are consistently trackable and attributable: - form submissions - meeting booked (where trackable) -  webinar/event registrations and attendance (tool-agnostic) -  Build a campaign dashboard v1 showing: - contacts associated/influenced by campaign - conversions by campaign (forms + meetings where possible) - clear metric definitions and validation notes 4) MQL gate + lifecycle stage alignment (single source of truth) - Confirm and enforce one source of truth for: - what counts as MQL - lifecycle stage movement - scoring thresholds - Clean up lifecycle stages and align to Salesforce reality: - HubSpot owns Lead/MQL logic - Salesforce owns SQL/outcomes/opportunities/pipeline 5) Lead scoring (Fit + Intent) Implement/adjust scoring so it reflects Codal ICP and intent: Fit: title/seniority + industry (company size when available) Intent: page groups (contact us/work/capabilities/events), conversions, meeting booked, email replies Ensure scoring does not inflate MQL incorrectly (e.g., “any form submission” without exclusions) 6) Email health + segmentation hygiene - Audit list health (bounces, unsubscribes, unengaged segment, spam risks) - Implement: - suppression lists (internal, customers, competitors, no-consent, hard bounce) - unengaged/re-engagement approach - segmentation structure (ICP/persona + intent-based segments) 7) Salesforce alignment (in collaboration with Sales Ops) - Collaborate with Salesforce owner to ensure: -SQL/outcomes sync back to HubSpot for visibility (nurture/disqualified/opp) - mapping rules are documented and consistent - You won’t own Salesforce architecture, but you must drive clean coordination for reporting. Deliverables (non-negotiable) By end of 4 weeks you will deliver: Campaign Governance Pack (naming, UTMs, asset checklist, QA checklist) Campaign templates (webinar/event, content, paid/partner) Campaign audit summary (10–15 campaigns reviewed + fix plan) Campaign dashboard v1 (contacts + conversions by campaign + metric definitions) MQL/lifecycle/scoring alignment summary (single source of truth + workflow logic) Email hygiene + segmentation improvements (suppression + unengaged approach) Training + SOPs + Loom walkthrough Change log / handover pack (what changed, where it lives, how to maintain it) Required experience 5+ years hands-on HubSpot Marketing Ops / HubSpot implementation Proven campaign governance delivery (UTMs + templates + enforcement) Strong data hygiene capability (properties, lists, forms, duplicates approach) Comfortable building workflows, dashboards, and guardrails Experience collaborating with Salesforce teams (handoff + reporting constraints) Execution mindset: you can implement quickly with minimal supervision (not “learning on the job”)

title: HOA Manager
description: The HOA Property Manager is responsible for the day?to?day operations, governance support, vendor oversight, and owner/resident experience across an assigned portfolio of homeowner associations. This role requires strong analytical ability, impeccable attention to detail, and exceptional written and verbal communication skills. The manager serves as the primary liaison among the Board of Directors, unit owners, residents, vendors, and internal teams (Maintenance and Finance), ensuring that association operations comply with governing documents, applicable laws, and company standards while meeting service-level and financial targets. Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like): Accurate, timely Board packets and meeting facilitation with clear minutes and action logs Portfolio-level adherence to budgets, assessments, and reserve funding plans in partnership with Finance HOA Proactive maintenance planning and on-time completion of preventive and corrective work with Maintenance HOA High owner/resident satisfaction, timely resolution of requests, and transparent communications Clean annual audits, renewed insurance policies, and documented compliance with statutes and governing documents Up-to-date task/project management in Asana and on-time delivery of recurring HOA cycles and filings Key Responsibilities: 1) Board & Governance Management Serve as the primary point of contact for Board members; prepare agendas, Board packets, and management reports for regular and special meetings. Interpret and apply governing documents (CC&Rs, bylaws, rules) and relevant state statutes in daily operations; coordinate with counsel when required. Facilitate annual meetings, elections, and owner notices in accordance with legal and governing document requirements. 2) Owner & Resident Relations Maintain responsive, professional communication with trustees/Board, unit owners, and residents via email , phone, and portal. Issue timely association-wide notices (policy changes, maintenance schedules, community events, compliance reminders). Manage and resolve escalations, complaints, architectural review requests (ARC), violations, and hearings within established SLAs. 3) Financial Coordination & Reporting Support budget development, reserve study implementation, and monthly variance commentary; review financials for accuracy. Monitor assessment billing, collections, payment plans, and delinquency follow-up in alignment with collection policies. Review and approve invoices, code expenses to budgets, and validate vendor work completion prior to payment. 4) Maintenance, Projects & Vendor Management (with Maintenance HOA) Translate Board priorities into annual maintenance calendars; schedule and track preventive maintenance and inspections. Open, monitor, and close work orders; ensure scope, SLA, and quality standards are met; maintain accurate asset records. Bid, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts (landscaping, janitorial, security, pools, roofing, elevators, etc.); perform periodic vendor reviews. Coordinate capital improvement projects (RFPs, proposals, schedules, owner notifications, punch lists, closeout documents). 5) Information Management & Systems Keep all HOA Asana projects/boards current with daily updates, dependencies, and follow-ups; maintain recurring tasks and automations. Process resale and lender questionnaire packages accurately and within service timelines; maintain fee schedules. Maintain organized digital records (governing docs, minutes, contracts, insurance, warranties, architectural files) in the association’s repository. 6) Team Leadership & Development Train and onboard new APMs/PMs on processes, systems (Asana, accounting/portal), compliance, and customer service standards. Promote a collaborative, service-oriented culture aligned with company values; escalate staffing/resource needs to the Unit Head. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): On-time completion rate for recurring HOA tasks and compliance filings Work-order first-response and average time-to-close (by priority) Delinquency rate and collections effectiveness; percent of assessments collected Budget adherence (OPEX/CapEx) and variance accuracy; invoice cycle time Owner/resident satisfaction score; complaint resolution time Board satisfaction score (post-meeting surveys) and action-item closure rate Qualifications: 3+ years of HOA/condo association management or related property management experience Demonstrated proficiency with task/project management tools (Asana) and owner portals; strong Excel/Google Sheets skills Exceptional communication (written and verbal), meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills; high attention to detail Working knowledge of governing documents, meeting procedures, collections, elections, and common HOA statutes

Your job is to keep the business running smoothly across four core areas — YouTube content, UGC, finance and organisation, and Facebook ads. You are not just executing tasks. You are managing and building systems, documenting them, and making sure everything is replicable without you having to explain it twice. When something looks off, you flag it. You handle it independently and flag us only when something genuinely needs our eyes. 5. Run the Business: This is the underlying point of everything above. If Joel and Joshua are away for four weeks, six weeks, or longer — the business does not slow down. It grows. You are not a caretaker. You are the person who keeps Ji moving, improving, and scaling in our absence. Every system you build, every process you document, every decision you make should be with that standard in mind. Tools You'll Use: *(Includes but is not limited to)* | Notion | Operating hub — SOPs, scripts, content system | | Airtable | UGC content bank and pipeline management | | Xero | Financial tracking and reconciliation | | YouTube Studio | Scheduling and performance analysis | | Meta Ads Manager | Ad backup — campaign management and uploading | | Loom | SOP and process documentation | | Claude/ chatgpt | Expediting efficiency and brainstorming | How Your Week Works: - YouTube — scripting, editor coordination, scheduling, and performance review on a rolling weekly basis in line with the 7-video target - UGC — creator communications and pipeline management are ongoing - Organisation — Notion and Airtable are always tidy; Xero is never left to fall behind, statements reconciled weekly - Ads — when needed, you're ready to step in without a handover Who We're Looking For: - Proven operations or systems management experience — we will not be your training ground - Strong Notion skills — fluent and able to optimise existing workspaces - Comfortable with Airtable and basic financial literacy in Xero - Experience building SOPs and documenting processes via Loom - Experience coordinating remote creative teams The person: proactive, self-directed, communicative, intuitive, growth-minded. You don't wait to be told what to do — you tell us what you're doing. Radio silence is not in your How We Communicate: - A brief message at the start of your day — what you're working on - A summary at the end of the day — what got done and what didn't - Weekly video call with Joel and Joshua — sync, progress, priorities - All communication via WhatsApp group We are not micromanagers. title: Senior Product Intelligence Analyst (Amazon DTC, US Supplement Brand)
job_title: Senior Product Intelligence Analyst (Amazon DTC, US Supplement Brand)
description: PHP 208,000/month base. Bonus on top. Direct hire by a US founder who's built two supplement brands in the New York area. Not an agency. Not a BPO. You'll be the senior analyst seat at a US-based supplement and functional food company. You live inside Amazon Brand Analytics, SmartScout, Helium 10, and DataDive every day. You spot category opportunities. You write the niche analyses that drive what products we launch. You iterate with our internal AI systems to land usable outputs. This is strategic work. Not data entry. Not VA tasks. Not transcription. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- THE JOB You're our detective and our analyst. You don't formulate. You don't run ads. You don't manage anyone. Half the week, you live in Brand Analytics, SmartScout, Helium 10, DataDive, Kalodata, and on competitor product pages. You're watching click share shift on the keywords that matter. You're noticing when an emerging brand jumps three tiers in 60 days and asking why. You're tracking which branded ingredients are getting picked up by which mid-market brands. You're spotting new entrants before they hit page one. You're catching what's trending on Reddit and Google Trends before it shows up on Amazon BA. The other half, you turn observations into niche analyses and iterate with our AI product development system. When something is worth pursuing, you produce a structured research document defining the opportunity: market size, keyword landscape with realistic and stretch targets, top 10 competitor table with revenue and formulas, competitor packaging analysis, regulatory flags, and a clear strategic angle with competitive positioning recommendation. Tight. Opinionated. Numbers cited. That analysis plus our weekly market intelligence report feed into an internal AI-powered product development system. The system produces proposals, packaging concepts, wireframes, spec sheets, and supplier quotes. Cadence: 1-2 niche analyses per week from initial research through final brief. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ THE WEDGE DISCIPLINE Every niche analysis must answer one sentence: why does a customer click us instead of the top three incumbents already on page one? Format wedge. Ingredient wedge. Audience wedge. Claim wedge. One of those four has to be defensible, or the analysis isn't ready to ship to the build pipeline. You will be the person who finds that wedge and writes the case for it. If you read this and think "yeah, obviously," we should talk. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- YOU QUALIFY IF: - 3-5 years at a US-based DTC brand, Amazon-native operation, or ecommerce agency doing product or category research - You've pulled Brand Analytics. You've used SmartScout or Helium 10 or DataDive in a real job - You can read a Top Search Terms report and explain what 70% click share at 1% conversion share means - You know what a 12 month growth +49% with 1 month growth -3% on a 730-day-old listing tells you, and how that differs from the same numbers on a 90-day-old listing - You recognize branded ingredients (Creapure, KSM-66, Magtein, Affron, GlucoVantage, AstaReal) and can verify a dose or form claim quickly - You understand basic supplement regulatory compliance: structure/function vs. disease claims, NDI status, GLP-1 framing risk, kids product compliance - You understand TACoS at launch vs. mature phase. You can talk to a PPC operator about CPR and rank cost Supplement, beauty, or functional food category experience preferred (supplements strongest) - Native or near-native English writing. Tight. No filler. No hedging. -2-3 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time during business hours required (your specific window is flexible) ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ YOU DO NOT QUALIFY IF: -You're a VA looking for any remote US gig -You've never used Brand Analytics or Helium 10 in a real job -You want a research assistant role with no strategic ownership -AI feels like a threat to your craft -You hedge in your writing -Iterating with imperfect AI tools multiple rounds per project sounds tedious HOW YOU'LL USE AI Our internal systems are AI-powered. The weekly market intelligence report is AI-generated. The product development pipeline is AI-powered. The AI does the heavy drafting. Your judgment is the shipping layer. Expect 3-5 iteration rounds on a clean brief, more on novel categories. Wrong doses. Non-compliant claims. Suppliers we can't source from. Capsule fit math that's off. You catch them, you push back with specific corrections, the system reworks. You're already using Claude or ChatGPT for 30%+ of your daily work. You have opinions about prompt structure. You've hit hallucinations and learned to spot them. YEAR 1 TARGETS 90 days: -Onboarded on the weekly market intelligence system, the product development pipeline, our branded ingredient library, and our regulatory framework - 4-6 niche analyses produced - Catching the majority of compliance errors and supplier mismatches in AI output before founder review 6 months: - 1-2 niche analyses per week as standard cadence - 4-6 of those analyses moved through the build pipeline to packaging or wireframe stage - Owning the unclaimed wedge cross-reference table updates weekly 12 months: - 40-60 niche analyses written across the year - 8-12 SKUs in market or in-progress trace back to your analyses - You own the weekly market intelligence read; founder reviews instead of produces COMPENSATION - Base: PHP 208,000/month ($45,000 USD/year) - Bonus: $2,500 USD per launched SKU that crosses $30,000 USD monthly revenue within 90 days of launch. Uncapped. Paid at the 90-day mark per SKU. - Paid via Wise, Payoneer, or direct bank transfer (your preference), Bi weekly - 20 working days PTO per year plus Philippines public holidays - Laptop and second monitor provided after 90-day mark - 90-day trial with clear deliverables. Both sides can exit cleanly. - Growth path to PHP 250, ---------- ,000/month range in 18-24 months as the role expands HOW TO APPLY Send to ---------- 1. Resume. One to two pages, English. 2. Two writing samples. Research documents, product briefs, strategy memos, internal docs you've produced for previous employers. We're judging the writing quality, not the topic. Work product from a US-based brand is a plus. 3. A 500-word take. Pick a supplement category on Amazon we should NOT enter. Name the category. Name three incumbents on page one. Show your data. Tell us why entering is a bad call. Be opinionated. ChatGPT-generic answers get cut on the first read. 4. A 10-minute Loom video. Open Amazon. Pick one supplement category you'd advise us to enter and one to skip. Five minutes each. Show your screen. Read the data out loud. Don't just describe the listings. Tell us what you'd dig into next and why. If we're interested: a paid 48-hour take-home ($100 USD) where we share a sample market report and ask you to produce one niche analysis. Then a 90-minute video working session with the founder reading data together. Then references. No phone screens. No 6-round panels. Two weeks to apply. One seat. We move fast on the right candidate. Thanks

title: Project Manager
description: Organization: Non Profit Hours: Part-time, flexible (estimated 15-25 hrs/week to start, may grow) Compensation: $7-10/hr USD Time Zone: EST ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION It started with a storm. After a hurricane devastated communities across Puerto Rico, a small team of volunteers showed up with tools, food, and a simple belief: people deserve to be helped. Three years later, that belief has become 200+ missions, 1435+ roofs repaired, 33 farms supported, 1,100 people fed - and a verified world record of 1.1 million acts of kindness in a single week. Now the movement is going global. Our Pay It Forward campaign is scaling to 200 countries with a goal of 1 billion acts of kindness. We are a local Puerto Rico and federally certified 501(c)(3) non-profit, and we operate the same way we always have - lean, mission-first, and built on people who actually care. If you want a role where your work shows up in someone's life, not just a dashboard, this might be your place. THE ROLE You are the glue between our systems and our people. We have a fully built tech infrastructure: Notion, Airtable, Slack, OneDrive, and Claude AI. Our systems developer has designed and documented the full setup and is creating SOPs and training videos. But he's a builder, not a manager. That's where you come in. Your job is to make sure people actually use the system. You help onboard new team members. You follow up when tasks go quiet. You answer questions when someone gets stuck. You are the human layer between a smart system and a growing global team of volunteers. The system is the engine. You make sure everyone knows how to drive it - and that no one stalls out. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Onboarding and Training - Onboard new regional managers, country directors, and core team volunteers into the tech stack (Notion, Airtable, Slack) - Walk them through SOPs and training materials created by the developer - Answer questions, troubleshoot access issues, and make sure everyone is set up and confident - Be the first point of contact for anyone joining the global team Project Coordination - Track tasks and milestones across the global team - Follow up with team members on deadlines, deliverables, and incomplete tasks - Send reminders, check in on progress, and flag blockers to leadership - Keep the Notion workspace and Airtable organized and current Systems Support -Know the tech stack inside and out -Identify when something is broken, confusing, or needs improvement -Coordinate with the developer or leadership when system changes are needed -Use Claude AI to support documentation, queries, and process improvements Communication -Attend brief weekly check-ins with leadership -Provide simple status updates on team activity and progress WHO YOU ARE Must-haves: - Solid experience with Notion and Airtable - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) - Must have Project Management experience - Must have reliable internet connection - Experience with volunteer-driven or non-profit organizations is a plus - Experience in Lovable and Wordpress website updating is a plus Personality fit: - Patient and people-oriented - you're working with volunteers, not employees. They need clarity and encouragement, not pressure. - Communicative - you surface problems early instead of waiting for them to grow - Mission-driven - you understand that behind every task is a real person who needed help - Calm under ambiguity - things are still being built, and you're okay with that

Pursue earned media placements — features, directories, and review platforms — that strengthen both backlink profiles and AI multi-source authority - Monitor and report on performance across all channels: organic rankings, traffic, AI citation frequency, and share of voice - Keep content regularly refreshed with updated data and "Last Updated" signals to stay competitive in both Google and AI retrieval - Implement and maintain content directly on the Calimingo website via WordPress What We're Looking For Must-have skills: - Proven experience in Generative Engine Optimization with a strong command of the traditional search foundations that underpin it - Strong understanding of how LLMs retrieve, rank, and cite content, including RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems - Solid technical search skills — crawl audits, site architecture, internal linking, page speed, and Core Web Vitals - Experience with structured data and schema markup, particularly FAQPage, Product, Article, and Organization schemas - Experience with semantic content architecture, keyword and topic research, and entity-based strategy - Familiarity with e-commerce content strategy and product-led search optimization - Ability to conduct comprehensive audits and translate findings into clear, prioritized action plans - Proficiency with search tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Google Search Console - Proficiency with AI visibility tracking tools such as Otterly.ai, Ahrefs Brand Radar, BrightEdge, or similar - Proficiency with ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Copilot, and Gemini for citation monitoring and testing - WordPress proficiency — comfortable navigating, editing, and publishing content directly on the Calimingo website Nice to have: - Experience with digital PR and earning placements on authoritative third-party sources - Experience with product feed optimization and merchant-facing AI platforms - Knowledge of knowledge graph optimization and E-E-A-T signals - Familiarity with agentic search (e.g., OpenAI Operator) and how structured content fits into agent-driven discovery workflows What Success Looks Like Within the first 90 days, we expect a comprehensive audit, a prioritized roadmap, and early improvements in how Calimingo appears — in Google results and in AI-generated responses — across searches like "best luxury pool designs," "pool options," and "pool builders near me." Our brand is “The Complete Safety Partner” and our tagline is “Creating Safer Futures, Today.” We serve employers and safety professionals nationwide. Staff Operations Hub Internal staff manage service requests, training requests, projects/tasks, document review, training packets, Safety Pro workflows, support tickets, and reporting. Safety Pro Hub 1099 Safety Pros onboard, upload compliance documents, view open gig opportunities, see assigned jobs, submit job reports/photos/files, and access training resources. Everything does not need to be forced into SuiteDash if Zoho, Google, WordPress, Zapier, or another tool is better for a specific workflow. Critical Training Signature Workflow OccuPros conducts safety trainings. We need a clean electronic workflow to: Collect signatures from all attendees on one shared training roster Collect individual signatures from attendees on their own training documents Store signed rosters, individual signed documents, certificates, and training records Compile final training packets Deliver completed training packets to clients through their SuiteDash portal Possible tools include SuiteDash Forms/FLOWs, Zoho Sign, Zoho Writer, Zoho Forms, Zoho WorkDrive, Google Workspace, WordPress plugins, LearnDash, Zapier, Zoho Flow, or custom automation. Responsibilities You will help design, build, test, and document the full system. Main responsibilities: Audit our current SuiteDash, Zoho, Google, WordPress/LearnDash, Brevo, and Zapier setup Recommend the best system architecture Configure three SuiteDash portals: Client, Staff, and Safety Pro Design polished dashboards, menus, forms, and workflows Configure file vaults/folder structures and role-based permissions Build service request, training request, support, upload, Safety Pro onboarding, and job report forms Create the training roster/signature/document workflow Configure project/task templates and statuses Configure support ticket routing Set up or document automations using SuiteDash, Zoho Flow, Zapier, APIs, or Google Workspace Plan migration from Google Drive/Zoho WorkDrive/Zoho Creator where needed Test permissions so clients and Safety Pros only see the correct files Provide screenshots, documentation, and a final runbook Required Experience Please apply only if you have strong experience with several of these: SuiteDash setup and configuration Client portals or CRM portals Zoho One, especially Zoho Sign, Writer, WorkDrive, Books, CRM, Forms, and Flow Google Workspace automation WordPress and LearnDash Zapier or Zoho Flow API/webhook workflows File permission design E-signature workflows Document automation LMS/training certificate workflows Operations automation Project/task workflow design Clean dashboard and portal design SuiteDash experience is strongly preferred, but a strong systems architect with Zoho/WordPress/automation experience may still be considered. What Success Looks Like The project is successful when: The Client Safety Hub is polished and production-ready The Staff Operations Hub is polished and production-ready The Safety Pro Hub is polished and production-ready Clients can only see their own company data/files Safety Pros can only see their own documents, assigned jobs, and eligible open gigs Clients can submit requests, upload files, view invoices, access training packets, and use support Staff can manage requests, tasks, training packets, reports, and reviews Safety Pros can onboard, upload compliance docs, and submit job reports Training roster and individual signature workflows work Completed training packets can be delivered through SuiteDash Automations and integrations are documented Final handoff includes screenshots and a runbook Project Timeline This project can take up to one month. We are not looking for the fastest setup. We want it done correctly, securely, beautifully, and in a way our team can maintain. How to Apply Please answer these questions in your application: Have you built SuiteDash portals before? Describe what you built. What experience do you have with Zoho One? What experience do you have with WordPress/LearnDash? Have you built e-signature workflows before? title: Demand Planner and Supply Chain Analyst
job_title: Demand Planner and Supply Chain Analyst
description: Company: Can Do Brands — a US-based consumer goods company selling mattresses, pillows, foam products, and household goods across Amazon, Walmart, Menards, and other major retail channels. Role: Part-time, long-term, remote. Approximately 20 hours per week to start, with potential to grow into a full-time seat for the right person. Reports to: US-based supply chain lead. What you’ll do You’ll be the hands-on operator behind our weekly demand and replenishment cycle. Each week you’ll pull data from multiple sources — open POs, in-transit shipments, on-hand inventory, channel-level sales velocity, and forecast inputs — load it into our inventory health and ordering model, and produce a clean reorder recommendation by SKU. Specifically: - Maintain and populate our weekly Inventory Health Status, Stock Position, Ordering Requirement, and Incoming Shipments dashboards in Excel. - Calculate reorder quantities using production lead time, ocean transit, warehouse processing, safety stock, disruption buffers, and order frequency. - Flag SKUs that are out of stock, at risk of going out of stock before the next ETA, or carrying too much inventory (overstock). - Keep product master data clean and current — SKU attributes, ASIN/UPC mapping, category, cartonization, cubic dimensions, master case pack, and container fill. - Reconcile PO data and forecast inputs from different sources, catch discrepancies, and escalate when something looks off. - Help us build the supplier order list each week, sized to container/FCL economics where it makes sense. You must have - 3+ years of demand planning, inventory planning, or supply chain analyst experience for a company importing physical goods from Asia (China, Vietnam, Indonesia) into the United States. This is non-negotiable — please do not apply if you haven’t done this work before. - Working knowledge of the Asia-to-US supply chain end to end: factory production lead times, FOB/CIF/DDP, ocean freight, container loading (20?/40?/40?HC), customs clearance, drayage, and US warehouse receiving timelines. - Comfort with cubic dimensions, CBM calculations, master case configurations, and container utilization — you should be able to look at a SKU and quickly tell us how many fit in a 40? HC. - Solid grasp of product master data hygiene: SKU setup, UPC/ASIN/case pack/dimensional weight, parent/child relationships. - Real inventory forecasting chops: weeks-of-cover, safety stock, reorder point, min/max, seasonality adjustments. You should be able to explain the difference between a stockout caused by a forecast miss vs. a supplier delay. - Strong Excel skills: comfortable with XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, SUMIFS, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and working in large multi-sheet models with formula-driven dashboards. Power Query is a plus. - Clear written English and the ability to flag issues proactively — this role lives or dies on catching problems before they become out-of-stocks. Nice to have - Experience with NetSuite (we use it as our ERP). - Experience selling on Amazon Seller Central or Vendor Central (FBA replenishment, IPI, restock limits). - Experience with mattresses, pillows, foam, or other oversize/bulky goods. - Exposure to demand planning tools (NetSuite Demand Planning, Streamline, Inventory Planner, etc.). - Familiarity with 3PL workflows and multi-node US inventory (East/West coast splits). Schedule & logistics Part-time, ~20 hours/week to start. Flexible hours, but expect some overlap with US Eastern Time for our weekly planning sync. Remote, work-from-home. You provide your own computer and reliable internet. We use Excel, email , and Slack. NetSuite access provided. Compensation Hourly rate, paid every two weeks. Rate based on experience — please include your expected hourly rate (USD) in your application. To apply: Send the following to ---------- with the subject line “Demand Planner – [Your Name]”: - Your resume (PDF). - A short note (5–10 sentences) describing one specific time you prevented a stockout or unwound an overstock situation — what data you looked at, what you d ---------- , and what happened. - Your expected hourly rate in USD. - Your earliest availability and weekly hours you can commit. Screening task: Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a brief paid Excel exercise (about 1 hour) using anonymized SKU data — calculating reorder quantities given lead times, on-hand, in-transit, and a forecast.
