description: Position Summary We are seeking a SOC Analyst (Level 1–2) to join our Security Operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for triaging security alerts, conducting in-depth investigations, performing root cause analysis (RCA), and recommending or executing remediation steps. You'll work across a modern security stack including Microsoft Sentinel, Defender, FortiGate, Netskope, ObserveIT, Auvik, and NinjaRMM - and you'll leverage AI-assisted analysis tools (including Claude) to accelerate investigation and response. This is a hands-on, technically rigorous role for someone who thrives on solving puzzles, communicating clearly under pressure, and constantly leveling up their security craft. Key Responsibilities Alert Triage & Monitoring Monitor security alerts and events across Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, Office 365), Netskope, FortiGate firewalls, ObserveIT, Auvik, and NinjaRMM. Perform initial triage of incoming alerts: validate fidelity, classify severity, assign priority, and determine whether an alert is a true positive, false positive, or benign true positive. Acknowledge, document, and escalate alerts per defined SLAs and runbooks. Maintain situational awareness across multiple client environments, tenants, and Azure stack workloads (AVD, Azure VMs, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure networking). Investigation & Root Cause Analysis Conduct detailed investigations into security i ---------- — pivoting across logs, endpoint telemetry, network flows, identity signals, and user activity to build a full picture of what happened. Construct timelines of events, identify the initial access vector, lateral movement, and impact. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) to determine the underlying conditions that allowed an i ---------- to occur (misconfiguration, missing control, user behavior, vulnerability, etc.). Use Microsoft Sentinel KQL queries to hunt across log sources, build investigations, and validate hypotheses. Leverage AI-assisted tools (including Claude) to accelerate log analysis, summarize findings, draft queries, and support investigation workflows - while maintaining analyst judgment and validation. Response & Next Steps Recommend and, where authorized, execute containment and remediation actions (isolating endpoints, disabling accounts, blocking IOCs at the firewall or proxy, revoking sessions, etc.). Coordinate with Tier 3 / IR specialists and client-facing teams to hand off complex i ---------- with complete context. Document clear, actionable next steps for clients — including technical remediation, policy changes, user education, and follow-up validation. Produce concise, professional i ---------- write-ups suitable for both technical and non-technical client audiences. Continuous Improvement Tune detection rules and analytics in Sentinel and Defender to reduce false positives and improve signal quality. Contribute to and maintain SOC runbooks, playbooks, and standard operating procedures. Identify recurring i ---------- patterns and recommend systemic improvements (control gaps, configuration drift, training opportunities). Stay current on threat intelligence, emerging TTPs, and vulnerabilities relevant to client environments. Required Qualifications Experience: 1–3+ years in a SOC, NOC with security responsibilities, MSP/MSSP, IT security, or similar hands-on role. SIEM: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel, including writing and tuning KQL queries. Microsoft Security Stack: Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, O365) and Azure AD / Entra ID. Azure: Familiarity with Azure stack components — Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Azure VMs, Azure networking, and core IAM concepts. Network Security: Practical experience reading FortiGate firewall logs, policies, and traffic flows. Endpoint & Cloud Tools: Exposure to Netskope (SWG/CASB), ObserveIT (or similar UAM/insider risk), NinjaRMM (or comparable RMM), and Auvik (or comparable network monitoring). Investigation Skills: Demonstrated ability to perform structured triage, root cause analysis, and produce clear i ---------- documentation. Foundations: Solid grasp of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP(S), authentication protocols, common attack techniques (MITRE ATT&CK), and Windows event logs. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication — able to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders. Mindset: Curiosity, attention to detail, and the discipline to follow process without losing the ability to think critically. Preferred Qualifications Industry certifications such as Security+, AZ-500, SC-200, SC-900, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, or equivalent. Experience in an MSP or MSSP environment supporting multiple client tenants. Scripting / automation experience (PowerShell, Python, KQL functions, Logic Apps, Sentinel playbooks). Experience integrating or working with AI-assisted security tooling (e.g., Claude, Security Copilot) for investigation and reporting workflows. Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, EDR forensic workflows, and basic malware triage. Familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS, HIPAA, SOC 2). What You'll Get A modern, well-instrumented security stack with real depth across endpoint, network, identity, and cloud. Direct exposure to a wide variety of environments and i ---------- types — accelerated growth vs. a single-enterprise SOC. Access to AI-assisted tooling that augments (not replaces) your analytical work. Clear mentorship from senior analysts and a defined progression path from Tier 1 to Tier 2 and beyond. Support for certifications and ongoing training. Working Conditions This role may include shift work or on-call rotation to support SOC coverage requirements. Remote, hybrid, or onsite arrangements per AlphaRidge policy. AlphaRidge is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Business Automation Analyst
description: Business Automation Analyst | US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time If your first instinct when doing something manually is “this shouldn’t be manual” — keep reading. To apply please fill out the application form here: ---------- /bepartofourteam. About the Company We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients. The Role You’re not here to maintain spreadsheets. You’re here to question why the spreadsheet exists — and build the system that makes it unnecessary. We’re looking for a Business Automation Analyst who sees manual work as a problem to be solved, not a process to be managed. You’ll analyze how work gets done across the business, identify what’s slow, repetitive, or error-prone, and build the systems that fix it permanently. Python, advanced Excel, AI-powered workflows, and smart automation tools are your toolkit. The outcome is a business that runs faster, reports more accurately, and depends less on manual effort over time. The Mindset We’re Looking For The best analysts we’ve worked with share a few traits: They see a manual process and immediately ask: “Why is someone doing this by hand — and what would it take to make sure no one ever has to again?” They take ownership. From the ---------- nt a process improvement is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s built, documented, and running without them. They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I make this faster?” they ask “why does this exist, and should it?” They communicate clearly. Progress, blockers, and outcomes are shared openly — before being asked for. They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to. Who Thrives Here People who are operationally sharp, intellectually curious, and genuinely excited by the idea of making a business run better. You don’t need someone to hand you a list of things to automate — you find them yourself. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful with tools, and you care more about outcomes than staying in your lane. We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is optimized and not every workflow is documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a gap — it’s the whole point. What You’ll Do You’ll walk into a business that has real operational inefficiencies — manual reports, repetitive data work, processes that exist because “that’s how we’ve always done it.” Your job is to find them, understand them, and systematically eliminate them. That looks like: Mapping workflows that rely on human hands and asking which ones shouldn’t — then building the automations that replace them Building Python scripts, data pipelines, and AI-powered workflows that turn hours of manual work into something that runs itself Creating Excel models and dashboards that give leadership accurate, real-time visibility — not end-of-week summaries compiled by hand Digging into messy, multi-source datasets and producing clean, reliable outputs that people actually trust Documenting everything you build so clearly that someone else could maintain it, improve it, or build on top of it — without asking you a single question Sitting with teams, understanding how they actually work, and translating that into automation solutions that fit the way they operate — not the other way around Continuously looking for the next thing to improve, because the work is never finished — it just gets better What We’re Looking For Strong Python programming skills — you don’t just write scripts that work, you write scripts that others can read, maintain, and build on Advanced Excel expertise (required) — Pivot Tables, Power Query, complex formulas, dashboards, data validation; you treat Excel as a serious tool, not a last resort Solid experience with SQL and database querying — you can get to the data you need without waiting for someone else to pull it Hands-on experience with AI tools and workflow automation platforms — you’ve actually built things with them, not just read about them Experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, or similar tools — you know when to code and when not to Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of an operational problem, not just the most obvious fix Natural systems thinker — you look at a process and immediately see how it should be redesigned, not just optimized Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there Honest communicator — you say what’s happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn’t good news Long-term mindset — you want to build something, not just fill a role Nice to Have API integration experience Background in MSP, IT services, or operations-heavy environments How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes) We’re honest about how we work with new tea ---------- mbers. In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand how the business operates, our tools, our standards, and where the biggest opportunities are. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn. As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their systems, their tools, and how the business runs. We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way. What Success Looks Like At 3 months: You’ve mapped the highest-impact manual processes in the business and have at least two automation solutions live and running Your documentation is already being used by others At 6 months: Reporting workflows that used to take hours run themselves Teams are spending less time on manual data work and more time on decisions You’ve identified the next wave of improvements without being asked At 12 months: The business operates measurably faster and more accurately than before you joined You’ve built systems that others rely on — and you’re already improving them again How We Work You won’t be micromanaged. We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it. There’s real work to be done — the business depends on it — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward. We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the automations, processes, and systems that make us better as we grow. This Role Is Not for You If: You need a detailed task list to know what to work on You build something once and consider it done You document only when asked You’re more comfortable maintaining existing systems than questioning why they exist Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus You’re looking for predictable, low-ambiguity work with clear daily instructions There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time. What We Offer Competitive salary based on experience 100% remote — no corporate commute, ever Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit Tech and internet allowance Paid vacation leave HMO Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to work smarter and automate more Career growth opportunities in a fast-moving, systems-focused environment

You are the holder of the standard, every day, across the whole company. This is not a punishing role, it is a reinforcing and rewarding one. You catch people doing it right, praise them publicly, build incentives that reinforce the behaviors we want, and address misalignment quickly and directly. You are how we keep A-players happy and how we make sure we only have A-players. The Stack You'll Run You must be highly fluent in: Asana (you are the guardian of Asana) Slack (team communication and real-time culture monitoring) Shopify (our e-commerce backbone) Google Drive, Sheets, and Loom (documentation and SOPs) AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, with the judgment to know the difference between a real, tested SOP and "AI slop" nobody can actually follow We expect you to leverage AI to move faster, but to personally pressure-test every output before it ships. EOS / Traction experience is highly preferred. You should already be fluent in Rocks, KPIs, scorecards, OKRs, L10 meetings, and accountability rhythms. Key Responsibilities 1. Culture and Accountability (The Main Job) Be highly active in Slack, Asana, meetings, and team workflows, monitoring communication, behavior, professionalism, and collaboration. Address issues immediately when standards are crossed. Pull people into quick 5-minute calls to correct behavior or clarify expectations. Prevent negativity, gossip, blame-shifting, passive aggression, or poor communication from spreading culturally. Catch and stop "AI slop" in the team's work, sloppy AI-generated outputs that have not been verified or thought through. Document concrete, evidence-based examples of both positive and negative behavior tied to our core values. No vague feedback. Use this documentation for coaching, promotions, reviews, warnings, and determining long-term fit. 2. Positive Reinforcement, Rewards, and Incentive Programs Publicly recognize employees who demonstrate ownership, urgency, preparation, communication, and professionalism. Run a steady cadence of small incentives (Amazon gift cards, shoutouts, peer recognition) for exceptional execution. Design and run structured incentive and commission programs for revenue-driving roles (sales, wholesale, paid media, retention), tying rewards directly to outcomes that move the business. 3. KPI, Rocks, and OKR Ownership You will not just tell people how they are doing, you will go in and check. Shadow each department to understand what people actually do day to day. Build KPI scorecards, quarterly Rocks, and OKRs for every department and role, with measurable weekly targets. Run check-ins, identify bottlenecks, fix root causes, and improve KPIs month over month. Our business is complicated with many moving parts. You will need to dig in to fully understand each role before setting standards for it. 4. Systems, SOPs, and Documentation (Quality-Controlled) Build TopFoxx's operating backbone from the ground up: clear SOPs, step-by-step playbooks, and Loom videos for every recurring process. Standardize folder structures, naming conventions, and templates in Google Drive. Personally test every SOP. Walk through it yourself end to end as if you were a new hire. If a layman cannot follow it without asking questions, it is not done. No AI slop, no theoretical playbooks, no "close enough." Re-test SOPs regularly. A stale SOP is worse than no SOP. 5. Coaching Leaders and Managers Several people on our team are extremely talented in their craft but have never managed direct reports before. You will help build them into great managers. Coach team leads on how to actually manage: setting expectations, giving direct feedback, running 1:1s, holding people accountable, and developing them. Help managers raise the bar of the people they lead, not just delegate tasks. Sit in on tough conversations and model what a direct, professional, accountable conversation looks like. Identify when a manager is the bottleneck and coach them through it, or escalate to the Founder if the gap is too large. Build a simple internal playbook for "how we manage at TopFoxx." 6. Onboarding, 1:1s, and Career Growth You own how people are developed at TopFoxx, from day one through every stage of their career here. Run onboarding for every new hire: be present every day for the first 5 days, then check in twice a week for the next few weeks, then settle into a weekly cadence. Build a job scorecard for every role that defines what success looks like, what the KPIs are, and what "great" means at each level. Build a career growth plan for every tea ---------- mber that maps where they are now, where they could go, and what they need to develop to get there. Hold weekly 1:1s with tea ---------- mbers to check in on progress, blockers, wins, and growth. Make development concrete, not theoretical. Every person should know exactly what they are working on, what they are being measured on, and what their next step looks like. 7. Asana and Project Management Clean up and restructure workflows, create consistent naming conventions, and build repeatable project templates. Ensure every task has clear ownership and a deadline. Create tasks, follow-ups, reminders, and accountability checkpoints. Reinforce review timelines, urgency standards, and deadline ownership. 8. Interpersonal Conflict Resolution Address tension, confusion, or recurring friction between tea ---------- mbers early before it damages culture or performance. Coach people toward direct, mature, solution-oriented communication. 9. Culture Presentations and Team Development Create presentations, trainings, and workshops around our values and standards. Continuously teach the team what "great" looks like operationally and behaviorally, reinforced through real examples and coaching. 10. Hiring, Vetting, and Talent Quality Conduct structured interviews that test judgment, ownership, and real execution ability. Check references thoroughly with hard, specific questions about reliability, speed, and integrity. Validate real past results, not buzzwords. Assess cultural fit against TopFoxx values of accountability, urgency, and clarity. Recommend final candidates to the Founder with clear, evidence-based rationale. 11. Operations Support and Role Backfill While culture, KPIs, and systems are your main focus, you will also help where the business needs it, including temporarily stepping into vacated roles so things do not fall apart while we hire a replacement. Be ready to absorb a vacated role short-term (customer service, ops support, project coordination). Structure workflows across Customer Service, Fulfillment, and Vendors. Create checklists for inventory and orders. Build Google Sheets trackers and handle general assistant tasks and project management for the Founder when required. 12. Reporting and Leadership Visibility Provide leadership with recurring reports on: Cultural health, team accountability, and communication quality. Strong performers, team risks, operational bottlenecks, and alignment with core values. KPI, Rock, and OKR progress across every department, month over month. Manager development progress: who is growing into a strong leader, who is stuck. What We're Looking For 5+ years in operations, project management, performance management, or systems building, with direct experience holding teams accountable and driving culture, not just managing tasks. Experience coaching first-time managers into strong leaders. Experience building KPI scorecards, Rocks, OKRs, and career growth plans that drove measurable improvement month over month. Experience creating SOPs and playbooks that people actually use day to day. Strong command of Asana, Slack, Shopify, Google Drive, Sheets, and Loom. Strong AI fluency (Claude, ChatGPT) and judgment to know when an AI output is good vs "slop." Excellent persuasive written and verbal English. You will be coaching, presenting, and writing for the whole team. Comfortable having direct conversations when standards slip, without being harsh or political. Startup or fast-growing small business experience preferred. E-commerce is a strong plus. EOS / Traction experience (Rocks, KPIs, scorecards, OKRs, L10s) is highly preferred since this is the system we are implementing. What You Get $900 to $1,700 USD per month plus performance-based bonuses, based on experience. Fully remote with flexible hours around 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern. Direct access to the Founder and leadership team. Opportunity to grow into senior leadership as we scale. Free TopFoxx products. Paid time off.

description: I'm hiring a long-term voice over artist to be the voice of my faceless YouTube channel — an old-school bodybuilding deep-dive channel focused on the Golden Era of muscle building (Arnold Schwarzenegger, Franco Columbu, Frank Zane, 1970s training). Neutral American accent — must sound 100% natural to a US/global audience ? Deep to mid-range masculine tone — not too high, not too gravelly ? Dramatic range — must be able to whisper a line, then deliver impact on the next ? Confident pacing — comfortable with strategic pauses and emphasis ? Storyteller energy — not a "radio announcer" or "corporate explainer" voice ?? Voices that won't be a fit: Heavy Filipino accent traces (especially on "th" sounds, short vowels) Overly young / "podcast bro" energy Monotone or "audiobook narrator" delivery Anyone who reads scripts robotically without emotion What You'll Be Doing Each Week:You'll receive: A finished script (1,500–1,800 words / ~9–12 min audio) Inline direction notes Reference clips for tone alignment Your deliverables: WAV file, 48kHz, 24-bit (no MP3 — too compressed for editing) Dry / unprocessed audio — no music, no reverb, no EQ (my editor handles post-production) Recorded in a treated space — no echo, no background noise, no room hum Delivered within 48–72 hours of receiving the script One free revision included per video Requirements: ? Minimum 1 year of professional voice over experience ? Home studio with proper acoustic treatment (no closet recordings) ? Quality microphone (Rode NT1, Shure SM7B, AT2020 or equivalent) ? Audio interface (Focusrite Scarlett or similar) ? Reliable internet for large WAV file transfers (Google Drive / Dropbox / WeTransfer) ? Excellent English comprehension (you must catch the nuance and drama in the script) ? Open to direction and revisions without ego ? Consistent voice across videos — same energy week after week Compensation: $50 USD per finished video to start (paid via Wise, PayPal, Cash App or your preference) Pay increases as the channel grows — I commit to revisiting rates every 10 videos based on channel performance Guaranteed weekly work once trial is complete Bonus structure when videos hit view milestones Trial Process: Apply with audio samples + the test read below Top 3 candidates get a paid full trial — record the first 90 seconds of a real script ($15 paid regardless of outcome) Best read gets the full first video at standard rate If the first video lands, we lock in a recurring weekly arrangement REQUIRED TEST READ:Please record the following 35-second hook and submit it as part of your application. Some influencer is telling you their new 'scientifically optimized' workout targets the upper-third of the lateral deltoid. He's got charts. He's got data. That raw, thick, three-dimensional look — it feels like a lost art. It's the difference between a CGI explosion… and real dynamite." Direction notes for the test read: Open conversational, like you're talking to a friend Slow down on "But something's missing… isn't it?" — let it land Hit "real dynamite" with weight — that line should feel almost physical Don't rush — the pauses are part of the delivery To Apply, Send Me: 2–3 audio samples of previous narration work (YouTube videos preferred) The required test read above (record fresh — don't send a generic demo) Your weekly availability and turnaround time Your sample rate/format defaults (confirm you can deliver 48kHz/24-bit WAV) Applications without the test read will be ignored. Why Work With Me: I pay on time, every time (Wise/PayPal, cash app fast turnaround) I give clear direction with inline script notes (no vague "more emotion" feedback) I commit to long-term partnerships and growing rates with the channel I respect your craft — you're the brand voice, not a commodity This channel is going to be built around YOUR voice. description: Schedule: Full time | Must work U.S. Pacific Time (California) Department: Pre-Suit | Plaintiff Personal Injury Reports To: Managing Attorney About the Role We are a fast growing, results oriented Plaintiff Personal Injury law firm seeking a highly experienced Senior Case Manager to step into a high responsibility role. You will manage high value personal injury cases from intake through settlement and close out. You will serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, coordinating medical treatment, managing complex insurance claims, preparing polished demand packages, and ensuring strict compliance with all deadlines. We are looking for a true professional who thrives in a fast paced remote environment, communicates directly, and can manage a high volume of details without dropping the ball. If you are just looking to coast, this is not the job for you. If you are driven by results, value clear systems, and want to be rewarded for your hard work, we want to talk to you. Key Responsibilities Client Communication & Case Management: • Serve as the primary client contact via phone, email , text, and client portal. • Onboard new clients and clearly set expectations from day one. • Provide regular case updates with empathy and professionalism. • Maintain organized, highly detailed case notes and next actions in our case management system. Insurance Claims & Coverage: • Open and aggressively manage Bodily Injury, MedPay/PIP (if applicable), and UM/UIM claims. • Rapidly obtain declarations pages, policy limits, and adjuster information. • Request, track, and file UM/UIM Selection or Rejection Letters for applicable policies. • Ensure complete and timely coverage verification for every file. Deadlines & Compliance: • Calendar and meticulously track California deadlines, including the 2 year statute of limitations and municipal/ante litem notice deadlines. • Maintain a standard of zero missed deadlines and perfectly accurate documentation. Medical Treatment & Records: • Coordinate medical provider referrals under attorney direction. • Monitor treatment progress and MMI status. • Request, track, and strictly quality check HIPAA compliant medical records and bills. Liens & Subrogation: • Open and tightly manage Medicaid, Medicare, ERISA, and private health insurance liens. • Obtain final lien demands and assist with aggressive reductions. Demands, Settlement & Close Out: • Prepare highly polished demand packages, including liability summaries, damages narratives, medical specials spreadsheets, and supporting exhibits. • Support settlement negotiations for high value cases under attorney supervision. • Process settlements, releases, disbursements, and case close out checklists. Performance Metrics (KPIs): We use KPI tracking to reward high performers with bonuses, not for micromanagement. You will be measured on: • Time from assignment to demand and settlement. • Coverage completeness (UM/UIM letters and verified limits secured within 30 days). • Medical records turnaround time and first pass completeness. • Zero missed deadlines and clean CRM documentation. • Time Zone Integrity: Strict adherence to 9 AM - 6 PM Pacific Time. You must be actively online, responsive, and working solely for our firm during these hours. Qualifications: • Proven plaintiff personal injury pre-suit case management experience. • California PI experience is strongly preferred (or a rigorous willingness to learn CA specific rules). • Deep working knowledge of UM/UIM, MedPay/PIP, medical billing terminology, and complex liens/subrogation. • Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills. • Highly organized, detail oriented, proactive, and tech savvy. • Prior experience working effectively in a fast paced environment. • Reliable, professional, and comfortable working completely independently in a remote setting. Technology & Tools • Experience with at least one major PI case management system (Filevine, Needles, SmartAdvocate, Lead Docket). • Comfortable with Microsoft 365. • Familiar with e-fax, e-signature tools, and VOIP systems. (Training is provided for firm specific tools.) Compensation & Benefits: • $2,500 USD Monthly, paid bi-weekly. Negotiable depending on experience. • 40 hour work week from 9 AM to 6 PM Pacific Time. • Aggressive performance bonuses tied to KPIs (Up to $1,000 USD). • Full time, long term position. • An efficient team environment with well defined processes, direct collaboration with a U.S. attorney, and major opportunities for growth. Why Join Our Firm • Stable, long term remote role (not project based) • Direct collaboration with U.S. attorney • Well defined processes and realistic expectations • Opportunity to grow with a plaintiff side personal injury practice How to Apply: To prove you have read this entire job description, you must start your application or email subject line with the exact phrase: "California PI Closer - [Your Name]". Applications without this subject line will be immediately archived. Workspace & Application Requirements: To support a successful remote work environment and ensure you are set up for long term success, applicants MUST include the following in their proposal: • A short Loom video introduction (2-3 minutes max). In this video, you MUST verbally answer Question #4 (The Furious Client scenario). Show us exactly how you would speak to this client to de-escalate the situation. • A brief view of your dedicated workspace. • A screenshot confirming your internet speed (Minimum: 50 Mbps Download) and computer specifications (Minimum: 8GB RAM, i5 processor or equivalent). (These materials help us ensure long term success in a fully remote role.) Answer the following questions when applying: 1. You have a California auto-collision file. The at-fault Geico policy is $15k/$30k. Your client's ER and physical therapy bills total $42,000, and they have an active ERISA health insurance lien. Walk me through your exact step-by-step strategy to get this file closed and put money in the client's pocket. 2. An adjuster from State Farm is refusing to tender a $100k policy limit, arguing that the client's MRI findings (a 3mm disc bulge) are degenerative and not related to the rear-end impact. What specific evidence and arguments are you putting in the demand letter to force them to pay? 3. You inherit a messy Filevine dashboard with 40 pre-litigation files. 10 are waiting on medical records, 5 are ready for demands, and 3 have upcoming statute of limitations deadlines in 60 days. How do you prioritize your first 48 hours on the job? 4. A client calls you absolutely furious. It’s been 8 months since their accident, they just finished treatment a week ago, and they are demanding to know why they don't have their settlement check yet. They threaten to fire the firm. Walk me through exactly how you handle this call, de-escalate the situation, and reset their expectations. 5. You get a new intake for an intersection collision. The police report incorrectly places your client 100% at fault, but your client insists the other driver ran a red light. The other driver is claiming your client ran the light. What are your immediate next steps to flip liability and find coverage?

Help standardize Speed Fabrication’s drawing templates, title blocks, notes, and CAD file organization. Manufacturing Support Work with Speed Fabrication’s team to help translate ideas into buildable products. Support laser cutting, fabrication, and powder coating projects with accurate CAD files. Assist with product development for online products, Shopify items, Etsy products, customer jobs, and repeat manufacturing work. Identify potential design issues before parts reach the shop floor. Help create repeatable designs that improve efficiency and reduce rework. Required Skills Strong experience with 3D CAD software such as: Fusion 360 SolidWorks Inventor AutoCAD Onshape or similar professional CAD software Ability to create accurate 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings. Ability to export DXF, STEP, PDF, STL, and other common file types. Understanding of sheet metal design, bend lines, flat patterns, material thickness, and formed parts. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings. Strong attention to detail. Good written communication skills. Ability to follow directions, ask smart questions, and work independently. Reliable internet connection and ability to work remotely. Ability to organize files clearly and consistently. Preferred Experience Experience designing parts for CNC laser cutting. Experience with press brake forming and sheet metal fabrication. Experience with tube laser or structural fabrication. Experience creating weldment drawings or fabrication assemblies. Experience designing products for powder coating. Experience working with American units: inches, fractions, decimals, gauges, and material thicknesses. Experience creating customer approval drawings. Experience with manufacturing businesses, job shops, or custom fabrication companies. Basic understanding of hardware, fasteners, weld symbols, tabs, slots, bend reliefs, and tolerances. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is not just a CAD operator. Typical Projects Examples of work may include: Sheet metal brackets Laser-cut parts Welded assemblies Guards and covers Custom signs Product prototypes Customer-supplied drawing cleanup DXF file preparation Fixtures and shop tooling Repeat manufacturing parts Assembly drawings Flat patterns for laser cutting and bending Software Requirements Candidate should have access to professional CAD software or be willing to work within Speed Fabrication’s preferred CAD workflow. Required export formats: DXF STEP PDF STL when needed Native CAD files when applicable Communication & Workflow This is a remote position. Communication may happen through email , phone, text, shared folders, project management software, or video calls. The candidate must be able to: Review project instructions Ask clarifying questions Provide estimated completion times Submit clean files Make revisions quickly Keep files organized Communicate when something is unclear or not manufacturable Compensation Compensation will be based on experience, speed, accuracy, and ability to produce manufacturing-ready work. title: Visual Storytelling Designer
description: If you enjoy designing eye-catching presentations and content, following a clear creative process, and being measured on your results, keep reading. About us: We’re the Creade Club. We coach Sport-Creators to benefit more from their audience. Clients are mostly successful Sport-Creators who are having trouble improving their business further. We’re now hiring Remote Canva Designers to help us build high-converting webinars. You do not have to write the webinar scripts or build the marketing strategy. Your job is simple: take the outlines and copy we provide and turn them into highly engaging slides and scroll-stopping graphics that hold our audience's attention. What you’ll do: - Design and format high-quality slide decks for live and automated webinars. - Translate scripts and outlines into visually appealing presentations that keep viewers engaged. - Make rapid revisions to slides and graphics based on feedback from the marketing team. - Hit clear daily and weekly targets (slide decks completed, turnaround time, design quality). - Keep our Canva workspaces, folders, and asset libraries perfectly organized. - You are not running the webinars or writing the copy. Your focus is high-quality, high-converting design. What we provide: - A steady flow of detailed design briefs, slide outlines, and proven copy. - Brand kits, presentation templates, and a library of our most successful past slide decks and creatives. - Training on our specific customer avatar and the visual styles that appeal to them. - Regular feedback so you can improve your design efficiency and visual storytelling. - A clear progression path for top performers. Pay and progression: - A fixed monthly amount plus - Additional pay/bonuses that increase with your output and creative performance. Strong performers who consistently exceed targets can earn more and may be considered for more senior creative roles over time. Exact details of the structure, targets, and progression path are explained during the interview process. You’re a fit if: - You like working within brand guidelines/templates and can adapt quickly based on creative feedback. - You know how to pace a presentation visually. - You’re motivated by improving your turnaround times and seeing your designs drive real numbers. - You have reliable internet, a working computer, a webcam, and a quiet place to work. Requirements: - Expert-level knowledge of Canva (specifically for building extensive presentation decks, advanced features, and file organization). - Strong written and spoken English. - Comfortable on Zoom and team communication platforms. How to apply: ---------- /t/6f5MPTTPdEus This is a short form where we ask about your experience, portfolio (please include slide deck examples), availability, and income expectations. If it looks like a potential fit on paper, we’ll offer you an assessment task. Top candidates from the assessment task will be invited to a short 1:1 call and a paid trial period. Job Type: Full-time Work Location: Remote

Core responsibilities Daily / Ongoing • Managing tasks, reminders, and follow-ups • Keeping systems organized and up to date • Tracking priorities and deadlines • Proactively flagging issues or bottlenecks • Communicating clearly and concisely Weekly • Light project management and coordination • Reviewing open loops and unfinished items • Improving existing systems and workflows • Preparing summaries and updates Ongoing improvement • Creating structure where there is chaos • Documenting processes • Suggesting better tools or workflows • Learning fast and adapting to new responsibilities What we care most about (non-negotiables) • Full-time dedication only This must be your only professional role.
